column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah 22 (M23022): evakuasi lewat terowongan; Faye gugur menahan lorong.
# Tetap Inggris: Jiangyu, Daiyan, Faye, Zhaohui, Vector, Monsoon Squad, Squad 404,
# Shell of Amni, Wildhunt, Mokosh, Mangi Security, Oathguards, Doll, Frame.
# Catatan: dua baris di file Inggris masih berbahasa Mandarin
# (当心！ = "Awas!" dan 啧…… = decak kesal) — diterjemahkan langsung ke Indonesia.
(Gunshots coming from nowhere echoed in the tunnel.)
column2: (Suara tembakan entah dari mana bergema di terowongan.)

column1: (*Boom! Boom, boom!!*)
column2: (*Buum! Buum, buum!!*)

column1: (The roar of artillery coming from nowhere shook the ground and walls, making them rustle and sway.)
column2: (Deru artileri entah dari mana mengguncang tanah dan dinding, membuatnya berdesir dan bergoyang.)

column1: (And amidst such continuous sounds of guns and artillery, in the dark and narrow tunnel, dozens of residents were moving forward with difficulty under the guidance of several Dolls.)
column2: (Dan di tengah suara senapan dan artileri yang tak henti itu, di terowongan yang gelap dan sempit, puluhan warga bergerak maju susah payah di bawah arahan beberapa Doll.)

column1: (Among them were women and children trembling and at a loss due to the flames of war, elderly people with mobility issues, and Oathguards forced to retreat to the second line for recuperation due to injuries.)
column2: (Di antara mereka ada perempuan dan anak-anak yang gemetar dan kebingungan akibat kobaran perang, orang tua yang susah bergerak, dan Oathguards yang terpaksa mundur ke garis kedua untuk pemulihan karena luka.)

column1: (Their evacuation transfer should have been completed yesterday, but was suddenly disrupted by the flying dragon descending from the sky. At this moment, they were the last batch of people transferring to the shelter in this city about to fall.)
column2: (Pemindahan evakuasi mereka seharusnya sudah rampung kemarin, tapi mendadak kacau oleh naga terbang yang turun dari langit. Saat ini mereka adalah gelombang terakhir yang dipindahkan ke tempat perlindungan di kota yang sebentar lagi jatuh ini.)

column1: Woo woo, Mom, I'm scared...
column2: Hiks hiks, Ibu, aku takut...

column1: I-It's okay, the big sisters from the Monsoon Squad will take us away.
column2: T-Tidak apa-apa, Kakak-kakak dari Monsoon Squad akan membawa kita pergi.

column1: Mhm, leave it to us! Little sister walked such a long way, very brave!
column2: Mhm, serahkan pada kami! Adik kecil sudah jalan sejauh ini, berani sekali!

column1: Here, this candy is a reward, you have to obediently follow us next too!
column2: Nih, permen ini hadiahnya, nanti kamu harus tetap menurut ikut kami ya!

column1: (Jiangyu smilingly rubbed the top of the girl's head, stuffed the candy into the girl's palm, and then continued to greet the people behind her.)
column2: (Jiangyu tersenyum sambil mengusap kepala gadis kecil itu, menyelipkan permen ke telapak tangannya, lalu kembali menyapa orang-orang di belakangnya.)

column1: Everyone, follow closely, this way!
column2: Semuanya, ikuti rapat, lewat sini!

column1: (Following her call, the residents lined up and moved forward. Not far beside her, Daiyan carefully looked after a few faltering elderly people, guiding them forward.)
column2: (Menuruti panggilannya, warga berbaris dan bergerak maju. Tak jauh di sebelahnya, Daiyan dengan cermat menjaga beberapa orang tua yang langkahnya goyah, menuntun mereka maju.)

column1: (And a few meters in front of Daiyan and Jiangyu, Faye held her axe and chopped forward vigorously, trying hard to clear this tunnel filled with gravel, rubble, and broken wooden stakes.)
column2: (Dan beberapa meter di depan Daiyan dan Jiangyu, Faye menggenggam kapaknya dan menebas ke depan sekuat tenaga, berjuang membersihkan terowongan yang penuh kerikil, puing, dan patahan tiang kayu ini.)

column1: (—According to the original map, this passage to the shelter should have been unobstructed.)
column2: (—Menurut peta aslinya, lorong menuju tempat perlindungan ini seharusnya bebas hambatan.)

column1: (However, due to the attack of that damn flying dragon, the dome was breached early, countless buildings on the ground were destroyed, and blind artillery fire poured everywhere. Many underground facilities were also impacted along with it, and this passage was one of them.)
column2: (Tapi akibat serangan naga terbang sialan itu, kubahnya jebol lebih awal, bangunan tak terhitung di permukaan hancur, dan tembakan artileri membabi buta menghujani segala arah. Banyak fasilitas bawah tanah ikut terdampak, dan lorong ini salah satunya.)

column1: (The sharp axe chopped down once again, and a wooden stake inserted horizontally in the middle of the road broke in half. Faye kicked away the broken half of the wooden stake, quickly confirmed that the passage ahead was safe, and then turned to wave at Jiangyu and Daiyan.)
column2: (Kapak tajam itu kembali menebas, dan sebatang tiang kayu yang melintang di tengah jalan patah jadi dua. Faye menendang potongan tiang itu, cepat memastikan lorong di depan aman, lalu berbalik melambai pada Jiangyu dan Daiyan.)

column1: That's good, hurry!
column2: Bagus, cepat!

column1: Alright! Everyone, we're going this way!
column2: Baik! Semuanya, kita lewat sini!

column1: Please watch your step, don't rush.
column2: Tolong perhatikan langkah, jangan terburu-buru.

column1: (Before Jiangyu and Daiyan could lead the slow-moving residents to the newly cleared position, Faye had already started to continue clearing obstacles further away.)
column2: (Sebelum Jiangyu dan Daiyan sempat membawa warga yang bergerak lambat itu ke bagian yang baru dibersihkan, Faye sudah mulai membabat rintangan yang lebih jauh lagi.)

column1: (And on the other side of the team, while looking after the residents moving forward, Zhaohui also cautiously paid attention to the gunshots echoing in the tunnel from time to time.)
column2: (Dan di sisi lain rombongan, sambil menjaga warga yang bergerak maju, Zhaohui juga dengan waspada memperhatikan suara tembakan yang sesekali bergema di terowongan.)

column1: (Until all the residents successfully passed this small "checkpoint", her brows were still furrowed, and a trace of faint displeasure was revealed on her usually stiff face.)
column2: (Sampai semua warga berhasil melewati "pos" kecil itu, keningnya masih berkerut, dan segaris rasa tidak enak tersirat di wajahnya yang biasanya kaku.)

column1: Zhaohui, are you worried about an enemy attack?
column2: Zhaohui, kau cemas soal serangan musuh?

column1: A little. There's still more than half the way to the shelter. At the current movement speed, it will be hard to dodge if attacked.
column2: Sedikit. Jalan ke tempat perlindungan masih lebih dari separuh. Dengan kecepatan gerak sekarang, akan sulit mengelak kalau diserang.

column1: Almost everyone evacuating right now are ordinary residents and the wounded. Is there a risk they will be attacked too?
column2: Yang mengungsi sekarang hampir semuanya warga biasa dan orang terluka. Apa mereka juga berisiko diserang?

column1: I don't know, but we can't gamble. The other side has creatures like dragons and the Wildhunt.
column2: Aku tidak tahu, tapi kita tidak boleh berjudi. Pihak sana punya makhluk seperti naga dan Wildhunt.

column1: ...Yes, you're right. If the enemy cared about the safety of ordinary residents, they wouldn't have let that dragon attack like that.
column2: ...Ya, kau benar. Kalau musuh peduli pada keselamatan warga biasa, mereka tidak akan membiarkan naga itu menyerang seperti tadi.

column1: Hey! Sis, Zhaohui, don't just talk, you two come take a look quickly! There are a lot of things blocking the way here!
column2: Hei! Kak, Zhaohui, jangan cuma ngobrol, cepat kalian berdua lihat ke sini! Banyak sekali yang menghalangi jalan di sini!

column1: (Jiangyu shouted dissatisfiedly in the distance, and Zhaohui and Daiyan hurried over.)
column2: (Jiangyu berteriak kesal dari kejauhan, dan Zhaohui serta Daiyan bergegas mendekat.)

column1: (Just in front of where Faye was standing, half of the passage had collapsed. Several fallen wooden stakes were piled in the center, blocking the way, leaving only a half-person-high small hole on the right side.)
column2: (Tepat di depan tempat Faye berdiri, separuh lorong itu sudah runtuh. Beberapa tiang kayu yang roboh menumpuk di tengah, menghalangi jalan, hanya menyisakan lubang kecil setinggi separuh badan di sisi kanan.)

column1: ...Tch. This is troublesome.
column2: ...Cih. Ini merepotkan.

column1: Going back now might not lead to a safer path.
column2: Kembali sekarang pun belum tentu menemukan jalan yang lebih aman.

column1: Uwaah, so what do we do now? Are we going to force our way through this path?
column2: Uwaah, jadi sekarang bagaimana? Kita mau menerobos paksa lewat jalan ini?

column1: There's no signal on the surface anymore. Our time... I don't know if it's enough either.
column2: Di permukaan sudah tidak ada sinyal lagi. Waktu kita... aku juga tidak tahu apa masih cukup.

column1: Faye, based on your experience, how long will it take for us to work together to clear this tunnel?
column2: Faye, berdasarkan pengalamanmu, berapa lama waktu yang kita butuhkan kalau bahu-membahu membersihkan terowongan ini?

column1: No need to completely clear it out, just widening the hole will do.
column2: Tidak perlu dibersihkan seluruhnya, cukup memperlebar lubangnya saja.

column1: There's no way through here, we're not going to be trapped and die here, right?
column2: Tidak ada jalan lewat sini, kita tidak akan terjebak dan mati di sini, kan?

column1: Mommy, Mommy, waah...
column2: Ibu, Ibu, huweee...

column1: Don't panic everyone, stay calm! We will protect you!
column2: Semuanya jangan panik, tetap tenang! Kami akan melindungi kalian!

column1: (While Faye remained silent, the waiting residents gradually grew anxious.)
column2: (Sementara Faye tetap membisu, warga yang menunggu perlahan makin gelisah.)

column1: (The shouts of the Oathguards acted like kindling, igniting the long-accumulated tense atmosphere. The residents began shouting over each other in panic, making the narrow and dark tunnel suddenly feel incredibly oppressive and suffocating.)
column2: (Teriakan para Oathguard justru jadi pemantik, menyulut ketegangan yang sudah lama menumpuk. Warga mulai saling berteriak dalam kepanikan, membuat terowongan yang sempit dan gelap itu mendadak terasa sangat menekan dan menyesakkan.)

column1: Enough!
column2: Cukup!

column1: (With a low shout from Faye, a sharp axe light suddenly chopped down, cutting off more than half a corner of one of the wooden stakes blocking the passage.)
column2: (Dengan bentakan rendah dari Faye, kilatan kapak yang tajam tiba-tiba menebas turun, memotong lebih dari separuh sudut salah satu tiang kayu yang menghalangi lorong.)

column1: (Faye walked to the side of the small hole, tightly gripping the axe handle, her brows furrowed tightly, as if making a resolution she had never had before.)
column2: (Faye melangkah ke sisi lubang kecil itu, menggenggam erat gagang kapaknya, keningnya berkerut dalam, seolah mengambil keputusan yang belum pernah dia ambil sebelumnya.)

column1: This path can be cleared.
column2: Jalan ini bisa dibuka.

column1: Zhaohui, you come help me.
column2: Zhaohui, kau bantu aku.

column1: One of us digs the hole, the other clears the wooden stakes. Always be careful not to let the top collapse.
column2: Satu menggali lubangnya, satu lagi menyingkirkan tiang kayunya. Selalu hati-hati jangan sampai bagian atasnya runtuh.

column1: Good. Jiangyu, Daiyan, take care of the residents and don't let anyone make a fuss.
column2: Baik. Jiangyu, Daiyan, jaga warganya dan jangan biarkan ada yang ribut.

column1: (Without a moment of hesitation, Zhaohui immediately walked over to Faye's side to assist with the clearing operation.)
column2: (Tanpa ragu sedetik pun, Zhaohui langsung melangkah ke sisi Faye untuk membantu pekerjaan pembersihan itu.)

column1: (The axe struck down, and the wooden stakes broke. Without digging tools, she used the broken stakes as tools, aided by her daggers.)
column2: (Kapak itu menghantam turun, dan tiang-tiang kayu patah. Tanpa alat gali, dia memakai patahan tiang sebagai alat, dibantu belati-belatinya.)

column1: (The wooden stakes gradually shortened and shifted, the sand and gravel on the tunnel walls slowly slid and rolled away, and the waist-high opening gradually expanded, widening and heightening until it was big enough for a person to pass through.)
column2: (Tiang-tiang kayu itu perlahan memendek dan bergeser, pasir dan kerikil di dinding terowongan pelan-pelan meluncur dan berguguran, dan bukaan setinggi pinggang itu perlahan meluas, melebar dan meninggi sampai cukup besar untuk dilewati orang.)

column1: (Only after confirming that the temporarily cleared opening was stable did Faye finally sigh in relief, stepping aside and nodding at the group.)
column2: (Baru setelah memastikan bukaan darurat itu stabil, Faye akhirnya menghela napas lega, menyingkir ke samping dan mengangguk pada rombongan.)

column1: It worked!
column2: Berhasil!

column1: Yes, start evacuating, leave here as soon as possible.
column2: Ya, mulai evakuasi, tinggalkan tempat ini secepatnya.

column1: (The residents started moving again, passing through the narrow temporary opening one by one. Jiangyu and Daiyan escorted them at the front, while Faye and Zhaohui also waited nervously by the opening.)
column2: (Warga kembali bergerak, melewati bukaan darurat yang sempit itu satu per satu. Jiangyu dan Daiyan mengawal di depan, sementara Faye dan Zhaohui menunggu tegang di sisi bukaan.)

column1: (Almost there, almost there, sixteen people left, fifteen, fourteen...)
column2: (Hampir, hampir, tinggal enam belas orang, lima belas, empat belas...)

column1: (Boom—! Boom boom!)
column2: (Buum—! Buum buum!)

column1: (The sound of artillery suddenly came from the cave roof very close by. The cave wall shook violently, and a crumbling piece of wall skin smashed down from the cave roof, knocking down half of the wooden stake that had just maintained its balance again.)
column2: (Suara artileri tiba-tiba datang dari atap gua yang sangat dekat. Dinding gua berguncang hebat, dan sekeping lapisan dinding yang rapuh jatuh menghantam dari atap, kembali merobohkan separuh tiang kayu yang baru saja menemukan keseimbangannya.)

column1: 当心！
column2: Awas!

column1: (Zhaohui suddenly pounced out, blocking the wall skin fragments for the girl walking on the path. On the other side, Faye had already supported the wooden stake with her body.)
column2: (Zhaohui tiba-tiba menerjang keluar, menahan serpihan lapisan dinding itu demi gadis kecil yang sedang melintas. Di sisi lain, Faye sudah menopang tiang kayu itu dengan tubuhnya.)

column1: It's alright now, hurry and cross over.
column2: Sudah aman, cepat menyeberang.

column1: (Quickly escorting the girl through, Zhaohui waved and rapidly called for the next one.)
column2: (Setelah cepat mengantar gadis itu lewat, Zhaohui melambai dan segera memanggil orang berikutnya.)

column1: (The elderly lady stepped forward and squeezed through the small hole under the dual protection of Zhaohui and Faye. Next was an injured soldier, his arm in a sling making his posture look particularly twisted as he struggled to squeeze through the hole.)
column2: (Seorang nenek melangkah maju dan menyusup lewat lubang kecil itu di bawah perlindungan ganda Zhaohui dan Faye. Berikutnya seorang prajurit terluka, lengannya yang digendong perban membuat posturnya tampak sangat kaku saat berjuang menyusup lewat lubang itu.)

column1: (Boom! Boom! Boom-boom!)
column2: (Buum! Buum! Buum-buum!)

column1: (The sound of artillery continued. The tremors coming from the roof of the cave made the small passage shrink bit by bit, and the ray of light that had once been opened up seemed to completely disappear in the shaking.)
column2: (Suara artileri terus berlanjut. Getaran dari atap gua membuat lorong kecil itu menyempit sedikit demi sedikit, dan seberkas cahaya yang tadi sempat terbuka seakan lenyap sepenuhnya dalam guncangan itu.)

column1: (Finally, amidst the continuous tremors, that fragile cave roof seemed unable to support itself any longer and collapsed without warning.)
column2: (Akhirnya, di tengah getaran yang tak henti, atap gua yang rapuh itu seakan tak sanggup lagi menopang dirinya dan runtuh tanpa peringatan.)

column1: But...!
column2: Tapi...!

column1: (Rain-like sand and gravel obscured the view. Jiangyu let out a scream on the other side of the cave. But soon her scream stopped—)
column2: (Hujan pasir dan kerikil mengaburkan pandangan. Jiangyu memekik di seberang gua. Tapi pekikannya segera terhenti—)

column1: (Under the sand and gravel, Faye supported that small tunnel.)
column2: (Di bawah pasir dan kerikil, Faye menopang lorong kecil itu.)

column1: Zhaohui... take everyone and go!
column2: Zhaohui... bawa semuanya pergi!

column1: Tsk...!
column2: Cih...!

column1: Jiangyu, Daiyan, quickly lead the residents to evacuate forward! Everyone else, follow me!
column2: Jiangyu, Daiyan, cepat bawa warga mengungsi ke depan! Yang lain, ikut aku!

column1: (Pausing for only a second, Zhaohui quickly turns around, takes hold of the next resident, and helps them squeeze through the small hole as fast as possible. After one passes through, she immediately moves on to the next.)
column2: (Berhenti hanya sedetik, Zhaohui cepat berbalik, menarik warga berikutnya, dan membantunya menyusup lewat lubang kecil itu secepat mungkin. Setelah satu lewat, dia langsung beralih ke berikutnya.)

column1: (On the other side, Jiangyu and Daiyan also grit their teeth and quickly escort the residents forward, trying to get away from the dangerous collapse zone as much as possible.)
column2: (Di sisi lain, Jiangyu dan Daiyan juga mengertakkan gigi dan cepat mengawal warga ke depan, berusaha sejauh mungkin menjauh dari zona runtuh yang berbahaya itu.)

column1: (Influenced by them, the residents also speed up considerably. Before long, the few remaining residents successfully squeeze through the small hole and evacuate toward the other end of the passage under Zhaohui's escort.)
column2: (Terbawa oleh mereka, warga pun jauh mempercepat langkah. Tak lama, beberapa warga yang tersisa berhasil menyusup lewat lubang kecil itu dan menyingkir ke ujung lain lorong di bawah kawalan Zhaohui.)

column1: Miss Faye...! Thank you, thank you!
column2: Nona Faye...! Terima kasih, terima kasih!

column1: Sorry, please pick up your pace!
column2: Maaf, tolong percepat langkahnya!

column1: (Having escorted the residents far away, Zhaohui sprints back. Jiangyu and Daiyan are also calling out anxiously from a distance.)
column2: (Setelah mengantar warga cukup jauh, Zhaohui berlari kembali. Jiangyu dan Daiyan juga berseru cemas dari kejauhan.)

column1: Faye! Hurry over here!
column2: Faye! Cepat ke sini!

column1: Faye! Seize the chance!
column2: Faye! Manfaatkan kesempatannya!

column1: (But Faye just tried hard to support the wooden stakes and bricks, and shook her head with effort.)
column2: (Tapi Faye hanya berusaha keras menopang tiang kayu dan bata itu, dan menggeleng dengan susah payah.)

column1: No, you... you guys... go quickly!
column2: Tidak, kalian... kalian... cepat pergi!

column1: Someone... needs to hold up the passage here... otherwise...
column2: Harus ada... yang menahan lorong di sini... kalau tidak...
Cih……

column1: (Understanding the situation almost instantly, Zhaohui turned and left.)
column2: (Nyaris seketika memahami keadaannya, Zhaohui berbalik dan pergi.)

column1: All personnel, speed up the evacuation!
column2: Seluruh personel, percepat evakuasi!

column1: (Watching Zhaohui lead everyone away, Faye also seemed to breathe a sigh of relief.)
column2: (Menatap Zhaohui membawa semua orang pergi, Faye pun seakan menghela napas lega.)

column1: This is... right...
column2: Ini... yang benar...

column1: (She turned her Frame's power to the maximum, supporting it with all her might.)
column2: (Dia memutar daya Frame-nya ke maksimal, menopang dengan segenap tenaganya.)

column1: (Her face flushed red, the falling gravel gradually buried her legs, and fine cracks bloomed on her skin.)
column2: (Wajahnya memerah, kerikil yang berjatuhan perlahan mengubur kakinya, dan retakan halus mekar di kulitnya.)

column1: (But she just gritted her teeth and flashed the coolest expression she could muster toward the direction her teammates and the residents were retreating.)
column2: (Tapi dia hanya mengertakkan gigi dan melempar ekspresi paling keren yang bisa dia kerahkan ke arah rekan setim dan warga yang menjauh.)

column1: Don't worry... don't... underestimate me!
column2: Tenang saja... jangan... meremehkanku!

column1: I am... a rescue Doll!
column2: Aku ini... Doll penyelamat!

column1: (Watching the crowd reach a sufficiently safe distance, Faye's Frame finally hits its limit, swaying before collapsing among the wooden stakes and rubble.)
column2: (Setelah menyaksikan rombongan itu mencapai jarak yang cukup aman, Frame Faye akhirnya mencapai batasnya, oleng lalu roboh di antara tiang kayu dan reruntuhan.)

column1: (Losing Faye's support, the tunnel that had once been broken open with a small hole finally met its end, completely collapsing into a patch of darkness.)
column2: (Kehilangan topangan Faye, terowongan yang tadi sempat dibuka dengan lubang kecil itu akhirnya menemui ajalnya, runtuh sepenuhnya menjadi kegelapan.)

column1: (Hearing the sound of collapse coming from afar, tears instantly welled up in Jiangyu's eyes. Zhaohui looked silently in the direction of the collapse, and Daiyan also lowered her eyes uncomfortably.)
column2: (Mendengar suara runtuhan dari kejauhan, air mata seketika menggenang di mata Jiangyu. Zhaohui menatap diam ke arah reruntuhan itu, dan Daiyan pun menunduk dengan hati tak enak.)

column1: (But the silence only lasted for a moment before Zhaohui patted her companions' shoulders and strode forward again.)
column2: (Tapi keheningan itu hanya bertahan sesaat sebelum Zhaohui menepuk bahu rekan-rekannya dan kembali melangkah maju.)

column1: We cannot let Faye's sacrifice be in vain.
column2: Kita tidak boleh membiarkan pengorbanan Faye sia-sia.

column1: Monsoon Squad, keep moving forward.
column2: Monsoon Squad, terus maju.

column1: (Another spark exploded on the outer layer of the Shell of Amni.)
column2: (Satu lagi percikan meledak di lapisan luar Shell of Amni.)

column1: (Even though it was built specifically for defense and guarding, this huge machine had already withstood excessive attacks at this moment, leaving several scars on its outer shell.)
column2: (Meski dibangun khusus untuk bertahan dan menjaga, mesin raksasa ini sudah menahan serangan yang berlebihan saat ini, menyisakan beberapa luka di cangkang luarnya.)

column1: (But even so, the pilot in the operating cabin still had no intention of stopping.)
column2: (Tapi meski begitu, pengemudi di kabin operasi sama sekali tidak berniat berhenti.)

column1: Right wing, follow my cover, continue attacking! Team 4's heavy artillery, keep up!
column2: Sayap kanan, ikuti perlindunganku, lanjutkan serangan! Artileri berat Tim 4, menyusul!

column1: (Under the cover of Amni's Shell, the Oathguard squad charges forward. The few remaining Doll squads also continue their offensive with this momentum.)
column2: (Di bawah perlindungan Shell of Amni, regu Oathguard menerjang maju. Beberapa regu Doll yang tersisa juga melanjutkan serangan dengan momentum itu.)

column1: (No, this isn't an attack, but the final defense—)
column2: (Bukan, ini bukan serangan, melainkan pertahanan terakhir—)

column1: (Under Mangi Security's overwhelming offensive, Mokosh's defensive line has retreated all the way to the front of the command center building. They have nowhere left to fall back behind them.)
column2: (Di bawah serangan Mangi Security yang menggilas, garis pertahanan Mokosh sudah mundur sampai ke depan gedung pusat komando. Di belakang mereka tidak ada lagi tempat untuk mundur.)

column1: (But even so, no one intends to give up.)
column2: (Tapi meski begitu, tak seorang pun berniat menyerah.)

column1: (Bullets continue to rain upon the enemy, while grenades and artillery shells are endlessly hurled at the incoming assault squads.)
column2: (Peluru terus menghujani musuh, sementara granat dan peluru artileri dilemparkan tanpa henti ke regu penyerbu yang datang.)

column1: (Ignoring the blood, sweat, and dust on their faces, the Oathguards raise their arms and shout, as if wanting to convey their mutual determination through that shout.)
column2: (Tak peduli darah, keringat, dan debu di wajah mereka, para Oathguard mengangkat lengan dan berteriak, seakan ingin menyampaikan tekad bersama lewat teriakan itu.)

column1: For Mokosh!
column2: Demi Mokosh!

column1: (The shouting Oathguards launched their final charge towards the enemy.)
column2: (Para Oathguard yang berteriak itu melancarkan serbuan terakhir mereka ke arah musuh.)

column1: (Infected by such shouts, the remaining Dolls of Squad 404 Team 2 also stepped out from behind cover one by one.)
column2: (Tertular teriakan itu, sisa Doll dari Tim 2 Squad 404 pun satu per satu melangkah keluar dari balik perlindungan.)

column1: (Nodding to the squad members, Vector also raised her gun high.)
column2: (Sambil mengangguk pada anggota regunya, Vector juga mengangkat senjatanya tinggi-tinggi.)

column1: For... Mokosh.
column2: Demi... Mokosh.

column1: (—If it were before yesterday, perhaps some people would still feel a glimmer of luck about Mangi Security and the Financial Conglomerate's attitude after Mokosh was breached. But after that flying dragon broke through the dome without any scruples, all illusions of luck were shattered.)
column2: (—Kalau ini terjadi sebelum kemarin, mungkin sebagian orang masih menyimpan secercah harap pada sikap Mangi Security dan Financial Conglomerate setelah Mokosh jebol. Tapi setelah naga terbang itu merobek kubah tanpa sungkan sedikit pun, semua ilusi keberuntungan itu hancur.)

column1: (At this moment, there are still remaining residents transferring underground. They must become Mokosh's last line of defense.)
column2: (Saat ini masih ada warga tersisa yang sedang dipindahkan di bawah tanah. Mereka harus menjadi garis pertahanan terakhir Mokosh.)
